title: WATCH: First sitting of the 15th Latvian Saeima
summary_full: Tuesday, November 3rd sees the first sitting of the 15th Saeima, following national elections one month ago. In accordance with the Constitution of the Republic of Latvia, the newly elected Saeima convenes for its first session on the first Tuesday of November, when the term of office of the previous Saeima also ends.
